name: Rosewater Manor
source:
You are a detective investigating a missing persons case, some girls seem to have simply vanished and with the case becoming colder and no real leads it ends up in your hands. Your wits land you a solid lead and after following it you arrive at the strange Rosewater Manor. After a rocky start with the beautiful blonde Lucy Hale, you soon find most of the girls in the house but there's a catch... They seem to believe that they are witches and that they are being haunted by a demon that wants to use them for his own gain. One of them also claims that their power comes from the erotic and that it helps them recover their magical power. After several strange things happen you start to believe them, you are all trapped in an area around the house, unable to leave but for now you are safe... Or so you think. Things soon take an even stranger turn...

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/StrandedWithBenefits]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你是一名侦探，正在调查一起失踪人口案件，一些女孩似乎就这样失踪了，随着案件变得越来越冷，没有真正的线索，它最终落到了你的手中。你的智慧为你找到了可靠的线索，跟随它之后，你到达了奇怪的玫瑰水庄园。与美丽的金发女郎露西·黑尔 (Lucy Hale) 经历了一段艰难的开始后，你很快就发现了房子里的大部分女孩，但有一个问题……她们似乎相信自己是女巫，并且被一个想要利用她们谋取私利的恶魔所困扰。其中一位还声称他们的力量来自情欲，这可以帮助他们恢复魔力。在发生了几起奇怪的事情后，你开始相信它们，你们都被困在房子周围的一个区域，无法离开，但现在你们是安全的……或者你是这么认为的。事情很快发生了更奇怪的转变……

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/StrandedWithBenefits]Patreon[/url]]
